description: 1982 is the Year of the Water Dog in the Chinese zodiac, from January 25, 1982 to February 12, 1983. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 1982 is the Year of the Water Dog, a Yang year. It began at Lunar New Year on January 25, 1982 and ended on February 12, 1983, so people born in 1982 before Jan 25 belong to the Metal Rooster year.

sections.heading: When the 1982 Water Dog year starts and ends
paragraphs: The 1982 Water Dog year began at Lunar New Year on January 25, 1982 and lasted until February 12, 1983, the day before the next new year. Anyone born between January 1 and Jan 25 1982 therefore belongs to the Metal Rooster year that started in 1981, while someone born in early 1983, up to Feb 12, is still a Water Dog. The Chinese calendar is lunisolar, which is why the start date moves between January 21 and February 20 instead of staying on January 1. The same Water Dog combination also falls in 2042, sixty years apart, because five elements and twelve animals realign only once in each sixty-year cycle. Lunar New Year 1982 fell on a Monday, while the Western Sun was in Aquarius.

sections.heading: Water Dog personality
paragraphs: Empathetic, intelligent and adaptable, the Water Dog is a wise friend and natural mediator. The Dog's Earth contains Water, which tradition reads as intuition channelled into perceptive loyalty. People born in this year are often excellent listeners. Quiet worry and holding back their own needs are the usual cautions, eased by honest conversation. People often trust them with secrets instinctively, sensing their discretion.

Water is the element of winter, stillness and depth, and a Water year is traditionally said to give any animal intuition, flexibility and a gift for communication. Descriptions associate it with wisdom, empathy and the ability to find a way around obstacles rather than through them. Water-year people are often portrayed as perceptive listeners, diplomatic and quietly persuasive, able to sense the mood of a room before anyone speaks. The element is linked with reflection and with the unseen, so it adds an inward, thoughtful layer. Its shadow, in most readings, is drift: indecision, secrecy, and a tendency to take on the shape of whoever is nearby.

sections.heading: 1982 in numerology and the twelve-year cycle
paragraphs: In numerology the year's digits reduce to 2, the number of partnership, patience and diplomacy, and a 2 year is traditionally read as one for cooperation rather than solo pushes. The digits of 1982 add up to 20, which reduces to 2. In the twelve-year cycle the Dog is the eleventh animal, earthly branch Xu, with Earth as its fixed element and Yang polarity. The year element is Water, and in the five-element cycles earth controls Water. The year before was the Metal Rooster and the year after is the Water Pig.

In the traditional sexagenary count the year is called Ren-Xu: Ren is the Water heavenly stem and Xu is the Dog's earthly branch. Stems and branches alternate between yang and yin together, which is why yang stems only ever meet yang animals.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 1982?
faq.answer: 1982 is the Year of the Water Dog. It started on January 25, 1982 and ended on February 12, 1983.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 1982?
faq.answer: Check the date against Jan 25. Born before January 25, 1982, you are a Metal Rooster; born on or after it, you are a Water Dog.

faq.question: What element is 1982 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Water, a Yang year. The Dog's own fixed element is Earth; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 1982?
faq.answer: Ren-Xu. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Water Dog year?
faq.answer: 2042, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 2042.
